stories.headline: A teenager takes the 200 metre breaststroke world record
stories.summary: Shin Ohashi of Japan won the men's 200 metre breaststroke at the 2026 Asian Games in 2:04.83. That took 0.65 seconds off the world record of 2:05.48, set by China's Qin Haiyang in 2023. Ohashi is the youngest male swimmer to break an individual long-course world record since Michael Phelps in 2002.

stories.headline: The Chicago White Sox reach the playoffs again
stories.summary: The Chicago White Sox have clinched a place in the Major League Baseball playoffs for the first time since 2021. They had lost 100 games or more in each of the three previous seasons. A 9-1 win over the Kansas City Royals settled it.

stories.headline: Morocco counts the votes from its parliamentary election
stories.summary: Moroccans voted on 23 September to elect all 395 members of the House of Representatives. Preliminary official results give the Authenticity and Modernity Party, led by Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, 97 seats. The National Rally of Independents took 66 and the Istiqlal Party 65.

stories.headline: A glacier may have moved the Stonehenge altar stone
stories.summary: The six-tonne Altar Stone at the centre of Stonehenge came from northeast Scotland, roughly 700 km away. A team from Sheffield Hallam University and Curtin University modelled ancient ice movement and found that glaciers in the last ice age could have carried it as far as Dogger Bank in the North Sea. People would still have had to move it the rest of the way.
